description: The file implements a web-based Wi-Fi configuration wizard step, involving form rendering, validation, and JavaScript code for managing Wi-Fi network settings, including SSID, security, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to a server-side handler to apply network settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, prepares a JSON configuration object, and invokes set_config to save settings.
